text: Figure 5.5: Details of defining ExclusiveAreas in BSWMDT In addition to defining that a BswModuleEntity can enter an exclusive area or com- pletely runs in an exclusive area, it is possible to define possible nesting orders of exclusive areas. Furthermore one can define at which level of a nesting order function calls are invoked from the BswModuleEntity. The information on nesting orders can be used to analyze the call tree with respect to resource locking scenarios. emplate
